summary: @magda/semantic-indexer-sdk: static keyword matches in minified bundle without traced installer harm
details: The published tarball ships a minified dist/index.js in which keyword patterns co-occur (multiple POST call sites and a 'dyndns' string). The 'dyndns' token appears in a lexical context consistent with library code (identifier/string in the bundle) rather than a resolved network destination, and no specific installer-side secret read or hardcoded attacker endpoint has been traced to a reachable install-time or import-time path. The package declares itself as a semantic-indexer SDK for the Magda data-catalog project, and POST calls in an SDK bundle are consistent with normal API-client behavior. Without a traced data-source-to-non-first-party-destination pair, the shape is ambiguous rather than a confirmed exfiltration path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
